value.answer: There's no single number. It depends on whether your down payment is under 20% (insured) or not. Right now the lowest 5-year fixed insured rate is about 4.34%, and the lowest uninsured is about 4.44%. Big banks are higher, averaging around 5.14%. Rates are climbing this month, so they're moving up. I couldn't find a Toronto-specific figure, but the 4.34% is available in Ontario.
